description: Source code for the 'ParserDropDown' class, which manages dropdown list definitions and synchronization within the SuiteCRM ModuleBuilder environment.

classes.name: ParserDropDown
classes.description: A class extending ModuleBuilderParser to handle dropdown list parsing, saving, and synchronization across multiple languages and modules.

methods.name: saveDropDown
methods.description: Processes request parameters to save or update dropdown list definitions in language files and module packages.

methods.name: synchDropDown
methods.description: Ensures dropdown keys are consistent across all supported languages.

methods.name: synchMBDropDown
methods.description: Synchronizes dropdown keys across all languages in a ModuleBuilder module.

methods.name: synchDDKeys
methods.description: Helper to synchronize the keys of two dropdown arrays, adding missing keys and removing extra ones.

methods.name: getPatternMatchGlobal
methods.description: Returns regex pattern to match global app_list_strings dropdown definitions.

methods.name: getPatternMatch
methods.description: Returns regex pattern to match specific $app_list_strings dropdown definitions.

methods.name: getNewCustomContents
methods.description: Generates new PHP content for dropdown definitions, replacing existing definitions with updated ones.
